properties.description: Two gap detectors, the third leg of the root-cause vocabulary (dec:idea-how-does-root-cause-become-automatic-rule-hook-detector-or-composition, mechanism (c)). `fix_without_recorded_cause`: one aggregate finding over every ChangeEvent of change_type defect_fix or test_failure_fix that sits on no CAUSES edge in either direction and carries no outgoing INVALIDATES — a repair indistinguishable from a symptom fix. A CAUSES edge on an artifact the fix touched is deliberately not counted. Forward-only by parking: a fix GOVERNED_BY ruling=parks under an accepted Decision is skipped and counted. `defect_overtaken_by_change` (rule since 2026-10-03, chg:the-overtaken-defect-question-names-the-likeliest-fix-2026-10-03): one finding per open defect TemporalFact (no valid_to, no incoming INVALIDATES, not parked) for which some change may have been the fix, naming the likeliest first. JOINED changes come first — the defect CAUSES it, it MITIGATES the defect, or a repair's CHANGED set names the defect — any change_type, dated or not. Then NEAR repairs (defect_fix / test_failure_fix) dated on or after the defect's valid_from, the same day included, that CHANGED the subject or an Artifact realizing that subject alone. Never offered: a change that CAUSES the defect, one dated before it, and for NEAR a repair already recorded as fixing another finding, an undated one, one reaching the subject only through a file shared with other capabilities, or a non-repair; each is named in the evidence. Only INVALIDATES (or valid_to) closes a defect, and the question says so. Keyed on the fact and every change offered; an acknowledgement is remembered per change, so a change already judged is never asked about again for that defect. Measured on reflow2's own design 2026-10-03: 35 questions where the first rule asked 62, with the real fix named first for 9 of the 20 fixed defects a sweep confirmed (the first rule saw 1). Neither judges whether a recorded cause was right: both report absence of a record (dec:report-dont-judge).
properties.name: A repair joined to no cause, and a recorded defect whose subject changed with nothing saying it was fixed, are noticed by the loop
